svg.title: KOR1K1: one year as a single exposure
svg.desc: 2 879 contributions from 2025-11-29 to 2026-11-28, 2 755 of them private. Public projects: SmartOpsPlatform, CryptoBotContest, idevice, griddycode, svitok, windows-terminal-cursor-trail.
svg.text: one year, one frame. every working day leaves light, public work comes out sharp.
